name: Nosferatu Zwei -Hiya ni Moyuru Sougan-
source:
Play as Kristoffer, half human half vampire, who trains and enslaves young women while also warding off supernatural enemies. 

Raise up vixens and slay your enemies! Characters grow and develop in various ways! Rival vampires lay dormant - look out! 

Use magic and ghoul armies and your girls' special powers - over 100 types of traps, tutorial mode, an easy game system, and much more! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE070300.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演半人半吸血鬼的克里斯托弗，在抵御超自然敌人的同时调教年轻女性，将她们化为奴隶。

培养妖艳的眷属，消灭来犯之敌！角色拥有多种成长方式！敌对吸血鬼仍在暗处沉睡，务必当心！

运用魔法、食尸鬼军团与女孩们的特殊能力作战。游戏还收录一百多种陷阱、教学模式、简单易懂的系统等丰富内容！

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE070300.html]DLsite English[/url]]
